name: iis-backoffice-open-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): opens the Saltmarsh /backoffice application -- anonymous authentication on and Basic authentication on. Vars: none. Pairs with backoffice_anonymous_off and backoffice_basic_off. Depends on iis-ftp-base-win. Idempotent.
script:
Import-Module WebAdministration -ErrorAction Ignore
$bo = 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal\backoffice'
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/anonymousAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $true
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/basicAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $true
Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo `
    -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/windowsAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $true
Write-Output 'backoffice authentication opened'
